rows.title: The asymptotic threshold conjecture for complete bipartite graphs
rows.statement:
Let $K_{2,l}$ be the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $2$ and $l$, and let $\tau(K_{2,l})$ denote its list color function threshold.

**Asymptotic threshold conjecture.**

$$
\tau(K_{2,l}) = \Theta(\sqrt{l}) \quad\text{as } l \rightarrow \infty.
$$

The preceding theorem proves a lower bound of order $\sqrt{l}$, while the conjecture asserts a matching upper bound and hence determines the asymptotic growth rate of the threshold.
rows.source_name: Hemanshu Kaul, Akash Kumar, Jeffrey A. Mudrock, Patrick Rewers, Paul Shin and Khue To, “On the List Color Function Threshold”, arXiv:2202.03431 (2023).
